description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. This study collection uses two turbine pairs to compare upgrade detection. The vortex-generator intervention is real, with a June 2011 change date. The pitch-adjustment component is synthetic: power is increased by five percent above nine metres per second after a specified April 2011 date while the control turbine remains unchanged. Both derive from a common inland-wind experimental family. The artificial pitch effect must not be reported as an observed physical retrofit. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
